name: mystmd@1.12.0
body:
([full changelog](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/compare/mystmd@1.11.0...2210e7003a0b70d0f9884b5da81e98841f7b79e2))

## Enhancements made

- Add avif and webm to the list of supported extensions [#3084](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3084) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@goekce](https://github.com/goekce))
- Add keys to option/frontmatter warnings for selective `error_rules` [#3075](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3075) ([@parmentelat](https://github.com/parmentelat), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@claude](https://github.com/claude), [@rowanc1](https://github.com/rowanc1))
- myst start --execute-parallel [#3061](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3061) ([@parmentelat](https://github.com/parmentelat), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Support arrays in template options [#2910](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/2910) ([@parmentelat](https://github.com/parmentelat), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))

## Bugs fixed

- Manually call the link command w/ npm run link [#3110](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3110) ([@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))
- Remove `npm link` from `package.json` [#3106](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3106) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- 📝 Fix test invocation [#3105](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3105) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Run `bun audit` to fix some of our security warnings [#3104](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3104) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Use `bun run test` rather than Bun's test runner [#3092](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3092) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- 🐛 Handle unknown directives in myst-to-html [#3083](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3083) ([@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf))
- 🐛 Add blank line after typst block quotes [#3068](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3068) ([@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- Update minimum Node version to 22+ [#3064](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3064) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- 🐛 Preserve matched target identifier for case-sensitive cross-references [#2989](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/2989) ([@coretl](https://github.com/coretl), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf), [@claude](https://github.com/claude), [@fwkoch](https://github.com/fwkoch), [@rowanc1](https://github.com/rowanc1), [@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv))
- 🧹 Remove test-case patching in myst-parser tests [#870](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/870) ([@fwkoch](https://github.com/fwkoch), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))

## Maintenance and upkeep improvements

- Only trigger documentation update when a release succeeds [#2661](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/2661) ([@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@bsipocz](https://github.com/bsipocz), [@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv))

## Documentation improvements

- Add Developer API docs [#2882](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/2882) ([@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77), [@choldgraf](https://github.com/choldgraf), [@fwkoch](https://github.com/fwkoch))

## Other merged PRs

- 🚀 Release [#3062](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/3062) ([@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
- 🚀 Release [#2906](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/2906) ([@stefanv](https://github.com/stefanv))
- 📝 Typst template documentation [#1179](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/pull/1179) ([@roaldarbol](https://github.com/roaldarbol), [@agoose77](https://github.com/agoose77))
